Requirements / constraints (engineer notes):
- Index scale: target 30M embeddings at launch, design to scale to 300M. Must support sharded indexes and hot/cold tiers.
- Reindex cadence: daily deltas (minutes), full reindex window acceptable up to 4 hours (overnight). Incremental/upsert API required.
- Latency: reranking p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for 5-doc rerank path; embedding vector search p50 < 80ms for top-20.
- Throughput: baseline 100–200 QPS for global dev teams, burst to 1k QPS during incidents.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering leadership wants <$0.01 per query (embeds + rerank combined) as target long-term; willing to accept higher in POC.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models (Llama2 variants or Redwood-curated) for cost + control; fallback to hosted larger models for low-traffic, high-quality paths.
- Reranking: multi-stage pipeline: cheap ANN retrieval -> small re-ranker on top-K -> full-model finalization for flagged results. Must support caching of intermediate vectors and prefix-KV reuse.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdowns, request tracing, per-route SLOs.
- Security: Okta SSO/SAML + SCIM, audit logs forwarded to Splunk, enterprise KMS (HSM preferred), required data residency in us-east-1 for portions of index.
